reviews.title: No es la más peor
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for 1 week, the 7 day free trial. I have been studying quite a bit each day trying to get as far into it as I can. 

Until I got to the video lessons? I have tried like 4 times but I just do not care about that cute girl in your app, my guy. Why do I need this back story? I get that context helps with story building, but maybe instead of your story, listening to you talk about a dating app, have a mock up dating app. That is actual context.

Which brings me to what I really do like about speak: I could create basically that in the create your own lesson section or I could set up that scenario in free speak. 

Sure, I make a lot of mistakes in free speak. I’m trying so communicate above my level. I’m trying to say things that see important to me in my life. Sure it’s hard and frustrating to get so much wrong when I get so much correct in the structured lessons, but I feel like this is actual learning. I love it. And that brings me to my final complaint:

I saw a Facebook advertisement for speak. In that ad there is this robot promising to be my tutor. But instead I get like a wax drop with a face mask? It reminds me of…I dunno…a hazmat suit 8bit game or something. Which is cute. That would be a cute advert. I just don’t appreciate the dishonesty is all. It’s just graphics. It doesn’t matter. But it does make me feel like why lie about something that doesn’t matter? Then I can’t trust you with stuff that does matter…like my financials.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text:
I recently tried free trials of a bunch of language-learning apps and this one was my favorite by far. I tried a Japanese course (I knew hiragana/katakana already so had a little head start) and by the end of the free trial was already able to speak through several useful interactions with some confidence.

The only things that stopped me from subscribing right away were (1) there's no German course, and I'm currently preparing for a trip to Germany and brushing up on my high school German and (2) there was no "family" subscription - would love go be able to subscribe together with my wife instead of paying full price for 2 subscriptions if we both want it.

If either of those two things change, I will subscribe in a few months once my Duolingo subscription expires—if both of them were to change, I would subscribe instantly!!

reviews.title: Great app for brushing up on spanish
reviews.text: Great app for pronunciation, general speaking and flow. However, I wish there was more emphasis on learning words and their definitions. The app will throw new phrases and words that you don’t know at you, then blow past them as you progress. It’s up to you to go back and click the translations to know the words. I’d also enjoy it better if the entire app had the automatic progression feature. Some parts allow you to speak and it will move on to the next phrase as you get the correct answers. Other parts require you to constantly click the button to reply. I’m also having issues retaining the information I learn, but that could just be a me problem and not an issue with how this app teaches.

Don't waste your money. The app doesn't work. 
It doesn't even acknowledge that I have said anything. I'm saying the words over and over and nothing is happening until it makes a sound that sounds like a failure, then proceed on as if I did a perfect job. Doesn't seem like a reliable app to learn a new language if it can't critique my pronunciation.

reviews.title: I LOVE this app but I absolutely need this
reviews.text:
I love using this app a lot, but one thing I really wish for is that you add German I would love to learn German because of the way that app is structured and I’m just like I really wanna learn it. I was really disappointed that you guys didn’t have it so please I’m begging at it for me!!

Also, I feel like the text with learning how to say stuff is like really fast. I can’t hear it good and like usually I messed up on the words. So I wish there was an option where I can slow down the text so I can hear it better and be able to articulate what it’s saying.
